name: AUTHENTICATED CHECKOUT EMAIL PREFILL
changes: Automatically pre-fills checkout email from the active Supabase account session
Uses the cached account email immediately and verifies the user asynchronously without blocking checkout
Keeps the email editable and never overwrites it after the customer starts typing
Persists the prefilled email in the existing checkout draft
Adds a discreet account-prefill confirmation under the email field
Synchronizes customer and Admin PWA cache versions to 13.8.17
